svg.title: Crane operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as crane operator, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A two-button crane control pendant is paired with a separate suspended lifting hook. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
